files.Comparison.md:
# Recorded comparison

In clean fixture exports using MockHost A 1.0 and MockHost B 1.0, the team tested the root and nested layouts with two sample skills and the same install ID. From each export, they ran mock-host-a list-skills and mock-host-b list-skills. The root layout listed both sample skills in both hosts. A nested copy would require a sync step. The nested symlink layout listed zero skills in host A after the package was copied. Keeping both hosts on the same source avoids sync drift; any future failure to discover root skills warrants reviewing this choice.
